# A rope stand (generated by make_env.py), origin at the deck's rope-end centre, on the ground.
new
material new Wood --base-color 0.545 0.251 0.286 --no-slot
material new Deck --base-color 0.792 0.627 0.353 --no-slot
material new Cap --base-color 0.682 0.416 0.278 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Deck --size 1 --location -0.550 0.000 0.850
scale 1.100 1.100 0.100
apply --scale
material assign Deck
add mesh cube --name Leg0 --size 1 --location -1.000 0.450 0.400
scale 0.120 0.120 0.800
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Leg1 --size 1 --location -1.000 -0.450 0.400
scale 0.120 0.120 0.800
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Leg2 --size 1 --location -0.100 0.450 0.400
scale 0.120 0.120 0.800
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name Leg3 --size 1 --location -0.100 -0.450 0.400
scale 0.120 0.120 0.800
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name PostL --size 1 --location 0.000 0.420 0.700
scale 0.160 0.160 1.400
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name CapL --size 1 --location 0.000 0.420 1.440
scale 0.240 0.240 0.100
apply --scale
material assign Cap
add mesh cube --name PostR --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.420 0.700
scale 0.160 0.160 1.400
apply --scale
material assign Wood
add mesh cube --name CapR --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.420 1.440
scale 0.240 0.240 0.100
apply --scale
material assign Cap
add mesh cube --name Bar --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.900
scale 0.120 0.960 0.120
apply --scale
material assign Wood
select all
shade flat
export stand.glb
